info.name: Limitless Backend & AI APIs
info.description:
Complete, verified API surface for the Limitless cognitive-wellness platform.

There are TWO primary service configurations:
1. Node.js backend ({{baseUrl}}) — handles accounts, auth, user profiles, DB assessment storage, admin operations, subscription plans, contact enquiries, PDF storage, Stripe checkout, AND proxies AI question generation, response analysis, and PDF generation.
2. AI model service ({{modelUrl}}) — standalone engine for question generation, scoring/analysis, teaser/full PDF generation, and longitudinal analysis.

LIVE INTEGRATION STATUS on {{baseUrl}} (as of 2 Aug 2026):
- ✅ Google Sign-In — configured and live (real GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS set). '1b.' works with a real Google ID token now.
- ⏳ Apple Sign-In — NOT configured yet (pending an Apple Developer Program account + App ID setup). '1c.' currently returns 501 until that's done.
- ✅ Stripe — LIVE in TEST MODE (test secret key + webhook configured, webhook endpoint URL verified correct). Checkout sessions are real Stripe test sessions; use Stripe's test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 to complete one.

Auth flow for a NEW user (mobile app):
1. POST /api/auth/register — name/email/age/gender, and an OPTIONAL `password` field. Account is created immediately.
   - If `password` is provided (min 6 chars), it is set as the user's password (`tempPassword` in response is null).
   - If `password` is omitted, the backend generates an 8-character temp password, emails it, and returns it as `tempPassword` (app prompts change-password).
   Returns `token` (7d access) and `refreshToken` (60d) immediately.
   Social Auth: POST /api/auth/google or POST /api/auth/apple for one-call sign-in/registration.
2. POST /api/auth/send-otp — sends 6-digit verification code to email (devOtp returned in non-prod when SMTP unconfigured).
3. POST /api/auth/verify-otp — marks `email_verified: true` on the account.
4. POST /api/auth/login — for returning users (email + password).
5. POST /api/auth/refresh — exchange refresh token for new access & refresh tokens.
6. POST /api/auth/logout — revokes access & refresh tokens server-side.
7. POST /api/auth/forgot-password & POST /api/auth/reset-password — password reset flow.

Test scripts automatically save `userToken`, `userRefreshToken`, `adminToken`, `userId`, `assessmentId`, `enquiryId`, and `userOtp` to collection variables.

request.description: Returns status, service name, version, feature flags (database, ai, stripeWebhook, email, googleSignIn, appleSignIn), and current timestamp. Also available at GET / and GET /api/v1/health.
Returns status for the direct AI model microservice.

Registers a new user account immediately. No OTP needed beforehand.
- Pass `password` (min 6 chars) to set user password directly.
- Omit `password` to generate an 8-char temp password emailed to the user.
Returns 201 { user, tempPassword, token, refreshToken }.

✅ LIVE — GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS is configured on the server, this actually verifies real tokens against Google now (not a 501 stub).

Verifies Google ID Token server-side. Registers new user or links to existing email account. Returns 200 { token, refreshToken, user, latestAssessment }.

`idToken` must be a real ID token from the app's Google Sign-In SDK (using serverClientId = the Web OAuth Client ID) — a garbage/placeholder string correctly gets 401 'Invalid or expired Google token.'

⏳ NOT LIVE YET — APPLE_CLIENT_IDS isn't configured on the server yet (pending an Apple Developer Program account + App ID with "Sign in with Apple" enabled). This currently returns 501 { error: 'Apple sign-in is not configured on the server.' } for any request, including this one.

Once configured: verifies Apple Identity Token server-side, registers new user or links to existing email account. Returns 200 { token, refreshToken, user, latestAssessment }.
Emails a 6-digit OTP code for email verification (10 min TTL, 60s cooldown). Returns { sent: true, expiresInMinutes: 10, devOtp? }.
Verifies OTP and flips email_verified to true on the user account. Returns { verified: true, emailVerified: true }.
Logs in returning users. Returns 200 { token, refreshToken, user, latestAssessment }.
Exchanges valid refresh token for a brand-new access token AND new refresh token (old refresh token is rotated/spent). Returns 200 { token, refreshToken }.
Revokes current access token (and optional refreshToken passed in body) server-side. Returns { success: true, message }.
Changes user password. Clears temp_password and resets password_reset_required flag. Returns { success: true, user }.
Sends password reset OTP code to an existing user's email. Returns { sent: true, expiresInMinutes: 10, devOtp? }.
Resets password using OTP code from forgot-password. Returns { success: true, user }.
Fetches user details and assessment history (newest first). Requires self token or admin token.
Updates profile fields: name, email, age, gender. payment_status updates restricted to admin.
Stores assessment report for a user. Returns 201 { id, user_id, report_json, pdf_url, created_at, updated_at }.
Updates report_json or pdf_url on an existing assessment record.

item.name: AI Assessment Engine (Node Backend)
item.description: AI Proxy endpoints hosted on the Node.js backend ({{baseUrl}}). Includes question generation and response scoring (with fallback to internal question bank if AI service is offline). Passing `userId` to /api/v1/analyze automatically saves the result into MongoDB as an assessment record.

request.description: Generates assessment questions based on age & gender. Returns { assessmentId, sections, meta: { source, totalQuestions, scale } }.
Calculates cognitive scores & risk metrics. If valid `userId` is supplied in the request body, the assessment is automatically saved to MongoDB and `assessmentRecordId` is returned.

Proxies PDF generation to the AI model service and returns raw PDF binary. analysis must be the FULL object returned by /api/v1/analyze (needs at minimum: assessmentId, overall, domains, lifestyleImpacts, cognitiveAge, charts). Since 6 Aug 2026 this backend validates that shape itself and fails fast with 422 { detail: [{ msg: "analysis is missing required field(s): ..." }] } if any are missing — e.g. a placeholder/partial object — instead of forwarding to the model service and getting back an opaque 500.

Generates free/preview teaser PDF binary with locked sections. analysis must be the FULL object returned by /api/v1/analyze (needs at minimum: assessmentId, overall, domains, lifestyleImpacts, cognitiveAge, charts). Since 6 Aug 2026 this backend validates that shape itself and fails fast with 422 { detail: [{ msg: "analysis is missing required field(s): ..." }] } if any are missing — e.g. a placeholder/partial object — instead of forwarding to the model service and getting back an opaque 500.

item.name: AI Model Service (standalone)
item.description: Direct endpoints on the AI Model Service microservice ({{modelUrl}}). Used for direct model testing, schema inspection ({{modelUrl}}/docs), and longitudinal trends.

request.description: Direct call to model service for question generation.
Direct call to model service to compute cognitive scores and analysis.

Direct call to model service to compile PDF binary from analysis object. analysis must be the FULL object returned by /api/v1/analyze (needs at minimum: assessmentId, overall, domains, lifestyleImpacts, cognitiveAge, charts). This call goes straight to the AI model service (no pre-validation on our side) — an incomplete/placeholder analysis object will fail there with a 500. Prefer the "(Node Backend)" versions of this request, which validate the shape first and give a much clearer 422 error.

Direct call to model service for free preview teaser PDF binary. analysis must be the FULL object returned by /api/v1/analyze (needs at minimum: assessmentId, overall, domains, lifestyleImpacts, cognitiveAge, charts). This call goes straight to the AI model service (no pre-validation on our side) — an incomplete/placeholder analysis object will fail there with a 500. Prefer the "(Node Backend)" versions of this request, which validate the shape first and give a much clearer 422 error.
Computes longitudinal progress trends over multiple assessments.

Recommended client flow: Generates PDF via model service, stores file in MongoDB GridFS, links public URL to assessment record, and optionally emails link.
Note: Server enforces paywall when `teaser: false` (requires user `payment_status: 'paid'`). Set `teaser: true` for free preview.
analysis must be the FULL object returned by /api/v1/analyze (needs at minimum: assessmentId, overall, domains, lifestyleImpacts, cognitiveAge, charts). Since 6 Aug 2026 this backend validates that shape itself and fails fast with 422 { detail: [{ msg: "analysis is missing required field(s): ..." }] } if any are missing — e.g. a placeholder/partial object — instead of forwarding to the model service and getting back an opaque 500.
Public route. Streams stored PDF binary from GridFS.
Upload raw PDF file bytes directly to user file storage.

✅ LIVE in Stripe TEST MODE — real test-mode secret key configured on the server, this returns a genuine Stripe checkout URL (cs_test_...), not a 501 stub.

Creates a Stripe Checkout Session for $19 Premium Cognitive Wellness Report and returns checkout { url }. Open the url and pay with Stripe's test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (any future expiry, any CVC, any ZIP) to complete a real test payment — the webhook below will then mark the user's payment_status as 'paid' automatically.

NOT called manually — this is Stripe's own server calling ours after a real checkout completes (registered in the Stripe Dashboard, correctly pointed at {{baseUrl}}/api/v1/webhooks/stripe as of 2 Aug 2026). Included here purely for reference. A hand-sent request with a fake Stripe-Signature header will be rejected (400) — the HMAC-SHA256 signature can't be faked without the real webhook secret.
Public endpoint. Returns active plans sorted by price ascending.
Public contact/feedback submission form.
Authenticates admin credentials. Rate limited to 15 attempts / 5 mins. Returns { token, role: 'admin' }.
Admin endpoint. Returns all registered users with assessment history and credentials.
Admin endpoint. Returns detailed user object including assessment history.
Admin endpoint. Upgrades/downgrades user plan. `payment_status` options: pending, paid, demo, free, trial, suspended.
Admin endpoint. Deletes user account and cascades deletion of assessments and stored GridFS files.
Admin endpoint. Lists all submitted enquiries newest first.
